question: Which of the following Articles under Directive Principles of State Policy, in the Indian constitution provides the organisation of village panchayats?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 40.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 40,** 

 
 
• The State shall take steps to **organise village panchayats **and 
 
• endow them with such** powers and authority** as may be necessary to enable them to function as **units of self-government.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **Article 60:**

 
 
• In accordance with **Article 60** of the Indian Constitution, the **President **must take an **oath or affirmation.**
 
• It stipulates that the** Chief Justice of India**, or, in his absence, the **senior-most Supreme Court judge** available, administers the oath of office to the President.
 
• The same oath or affirmation is taken by any other **individual **serving as president or carrying out the **president's duties.**
 
 
 
• **Article 50:**
 
 
• The State shall take steps to **separate the judiciary from the executive **in the public services of the State.
 
 
 
• **Article 30:**
 
 
• Article 30 of the Indian Constitution states the **right of minorities** to establish and administer **educational institutions. **
